title: The airport & parking garage
content: Hey has anyone had a parking garage by the airport experience that feel scary? There are usually army/police type people in the parking garage and you have to go through a security checkpoint before going in. Once in the parking garage, you cannot find your car and you feel like you’ve been there for hours, but there is a roller coaster in the parking garage. It feel so creepy but also ‘normal’ if that makes sense. Anyone experienced this exact same dream? So if you’re looking at the parking garage, the airport is to the left and the parking garage is to the right.
